events.note: Four weekly parts (May 18 – June 8, 2022) of Dahyun on her own: eating alone in the JYP cafeteria, a Han River walk with her dog Ari, a day out around Yongsan, her skincare without makeup, designing a tarpaulin bag, a book café, and a finale at Hwarangdae Railway Park.

events.title: Earth Defenders: Sana (지구 특공대)
events.note: A sponsored RE:EARTH challenge for Lotte Department Store and the Korea Environment Foundation: Sana revisits her Cheongdam-dong memories and goes plogging around the neighbourhood.

events.title: Earth Defenders: Jihyo (지구 특공대)
events.note: The RE:EARTH challenge returns for 2024: Jihyo goes plogging at Olympic Park and around the JYP building.

events.title: What's That Sound?! Episode 10: Jeongyeon & Dahyun
events.note: Jung Hyung-don, their old Weekly Idol host, welcomes back Jeongyeon and Dahyun after the re-signing and the Talk that Talk comeback, and finds the seven-year veterans much harder to rattle.

events.title: I'll Give You Pocket Money: Jeongyeon (용돈 줄게)
events.note: Jeongyeon's second time on the channel, as the first guest of 2025: she answers back like an old friend and walks off with most of the pocket money.

events.title: Episodes 6–7: TWICE
events.note: TWICE take over a coin karaoke room. Both episodes are the full, previously unaired versions. Talk that Talk era.

events.title: Season 2, Episode 9: Nayeon
events.note: Nayeon joins ITZY as the guest, the week of her solo debut with POP!.

events.title: Nayeon
events.note: Moonbyul's guest the week POP! came out. A short part is cut from this copy for copyright reasons.

events.title: Episode 5: Nayeon
events.note: Nayeon brings her worry about being shy with people she doesn't know, and is told she doesn't need to change. POP! era.

events.title: What Is TWICE to a High-School Junior? (고2에게 트와이스란?)
events.note: Teenagers who grew up with TWICE look back on the group's career. Formula of Love era.

events.title: Jihyo
events.note: Jihyo works out with Kim Jong-kook, with bodybuilder Ma Sun-ho as co-host, and impresses them as practically an athlete. Killin' Me Good era.

events.title: Episode 2: Chaeyoung
events.note: Somi's "first-love unnie" Chaeyoung, just back from the US tour, takes on American hot food: stories from SIXTEEN and half a lifetime of friendship. The pilot's final episode.

events.title: Training Stories at JYP (트레이닝썰)
events.note: Lee Seok-hoon visits JYP to hear what it takes to debut there, with Jihyo, NMIXX's Haewon and Xdinary Heroes' Jooyeon and O.de. Jihyo is in front of the JYP building from 0:37.

events.title: Episode 27: Jeongyeon & Gong Seung-yeon
events.note: Sisters Jeongyeon and actress Gong Seung-yeon bring their dogs to show off, and end up bickering.

events.title: 안고독한 소식가: Nayeon & Jihyo
events.note: Former Wonder Girl Ahn So-hee, their old JYP senior, takes Nayeon and Jihyo to try Pyongyang naengmyeon for the first time. THIS IS FOR era.

events.title: Episode 12: Jihyo
events.note: Park Na-rae drops in on Jihyo's family campsite: being TWICE's leader ("I'll die five years early"), the re-signing, a tarot reading on the new song, and a campfire meal. Strategy era.

events.title: Episode 78: Nayeon
events.note: Nayeon, back solo with NA: the swings she goes looking for on her own, the selfies she takes when she cries, and her ideal type.

events.title: Episode 1: Nayeon
events.note: The show's first guest: Nayeon, Lia Kim's favourite student from her years as a JYP dance trainer, with stories from Nayeon's trainee days. NA era.

events.title: Tzuyu's Makeup
events.note: Makeup artist Risabae does Tzuyu's makeup, turning her puppy look into a cat look, for her first solo album abouTZU.

events.title: Episode 52: Tzuyu
events.note: Season 3's eleventh guest: Kim Jae-joong makes friends with Tzuyu, TWICE's well-behaved maknae, as she debuts solo with abouTZU.

events.title: Episode 4: Nayeon
events.note: A day all to herself: doing her own makeup, brunch in Seongsu, and raiding a shop of cute little things. NA era.
